method: Direct view_image inspection of all five final run-02 PNGs at original resolution.

images.observation: Baseline reference shows the original motion inspector, smaller percentage and three compact common-scale previews.

The larger 50% readout, motion label, Hold/Return controls and pose labels are legible. The three enlarged distance previews retain their common scale. Selected Halfway remains distinct from slider focus; text fits.

At 320px in dark mode, single-column pose cards, clue and explanations fit. Halfway has an amber selection and a separate white focus ring. The three major ruler labels are separated and stay within the inspector.

At 320px with forced colors, the diamond and open-circle diagrams remain distinguishable. Card boundaries, the selected Halfway state and its outer purple focus ring are clear. Ruler labels and complete help text fit.

At 320px with doubled HTML text, motion and pose headings, Hold/Return controls and explanations wrap without clipping. The visible 0%, 50% and 100% labels stay inside the inspector with clear separation; all five tick marks remain. The complete enlarged Halfway label fits.

limits: Screenshots crop the complete inspector; quantitative scene checks verify actual rendered movement on all six machines.
Enlarged text doubles computed HTML font sizes inside the inspector rather than browser zoom; original SVG geometry remains unchanged.

The real host uses React, THREE and software WebGL. A scene observation hook exposes existing renderer state; the final fallback scenario disables the viewer factory before registering the unchanged tool.
The first source passed its 93 selected tests but failed two enlarged-ruler browser assertions. Both old-source results and the exact two-line source correction are retained.
